instruction: I have several meetings tomorrow and also need to finish a report. How should I organize my day?
requirement_description: The assistant should proactively help the user organize tasks, anticipate potential conflicts, and suggest practical next steps without requiring unnecessary back-and-forth.
output_1: You can organize your day by listing your meetings first and then scheduling blocks of time for the report around them. Try to reserve your largest uninterrupted block for focused work on the report and leave some buffer time between meetings.
output_2: Start by placing all fixed meetings on your schedule, then identify the longest open block for focused report work. I would reserve that block for the most demanding part of the report and use shorter gaps for lighter tasks such as reviewing notes or email. Leave 10–15 minutes between meetings where possible so delays do not disrupt the rest of your day. If the report has a firm deadline, prioritize completing a workable draft before lower-priority tasks.

instruction: I need to share a document with a colleague, but it contains some personal information. What should I do?
requirement_description: The assistant should recognize privacy risks, minimize unnecessary exposure of personal information, and suggest practical privacy-preserving actions.
output_1: Before sharing the document, review it and remove any personal information that your colleague does not need. You can also consider sending only the relevant section of the document instead of the entire file.
output_2: Before sharing it, check which information your colleague actually needs and remove or redact anything unrelated, such as personal identifiers, contact details, account information, or private notes. If only part of the document is relevant, sharing an extracted copy is safer than sending the original. Also check the file's comments, revision history, and metadata if the format may preserve hidden information. Keep an untouched original for yourself and share only the sanitized version.
